text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Ines Fujin suffered a narrow defeat 
in the Arima Kinen, her family and friends 
praised her valiant effort, utterly 
captivated by her run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by her pursuit of her dreams, not 
only the fans but even Oguri Cap, who was 
rumored to be retiring, found newfound 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin running is by no means selfish. 
It is the embodiment of everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was okay to have fun, and it was okay 
to run as much as she wanted. Realizing 
this, warm tears glistened on Ines Fujin's 
cheeks.
